_how: The Vice Run (added 19 Nov 2026): a 48-hour GTA bonus quiz on the Games page. It shows only between start and end (UTC). Every answer is checked against 2+ sources (see gta-6-why-its-a-big-deal.html and its sources list). a = index of the right option before shuffling. img/pos = the picture on each question (all Rockstar Games artwork, credited on screen).
